title: Strawberry Tree: Old Arbutus Trees You Can Visit
meta_description: Madrid put one on its coat of arms with a bear reaching into the branches. Bergamo's on Via alla Rocca is 16 metres tall.
intro: Madrid put one of these on its coat of arms, a bear reaching up into the branches, and the tree on the Plaza de la Lealtad is the closest thing the city has to the original. The species is normally a shrub you can see over the top of, which makes the one on Via alla Rocca in Bergamo peculiar: 16 metres tall, with a trunk 355 centimetres around. Catalonia declared one near Can Genoer, in the hill country of the Baix Emporda, a monumental tree in 2000, at 8.5 metres about as large as the species is known to get. Autumn is the moment to go. Arbutus unedo flowers and ripens fruit at the same time, so a single branch carries white bells and red fruit at once. Florence's grows in the Giardino dell'Iris, and another stands on a wine estate above Nice at the Chateau de Cremat.
